newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - July 21.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - July 21.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Monday:
* On Friday, the Dow Jones industrial average fell 130.31 points, or 1.6 percent, to close at 7,890.46 on profit-taking.
* Indonesian President Suharto on Friday urged the country's top finance officials to exercise caution and take steps to prevent currency speculation.
* On Friday, the Jakarta Composite Index was up 0.50 points, or 0.07 percent, at 724.00 points after the index fell briefly on concern about a late tumble in the rupiah, brokers said.
* On Monday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,575.00/75.50 at 0148 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,510.00/20.00.
* Chemical firm Lautan Luas as it is scheduled to be listed on Monday.
* Indosat on reports it has bought a 13-percent stake in telecommunications firm PT Pramindo Ikat Nusantara for $57.2 million.
* Transportation firm Mitra Rajasa on reports it planned expand to air and sea transport.
* Soft drink firm Aqua on market talk of a possible alliance with a food and beverage firm.
* Indocement and Indofood after Indocement said it planned to sell its 50.1 percent stake in noodle maker Indofood.
